tasks.short: Mediate disputes and develop alternative planning recommendations

steps.what: Mediate community disputes and clarify interests behind conflicting positions
Assist participants in developing alternative plans or recommendations

tasks.design: Keep mediation and collaborative option development with the planner. Existing project information in {DOCS} supports discussion without turning community preferences into automatic decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: A planning dispute involves competing interests and trust, not simply missing text.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional component is proposed for mediation or negotiated alternatives.
tasks.still_hard: Unequal participation, unresolved conflicts and options that satisfy one group while burdening another.
tasks.human_edge: The planner listens, questions assumptions and recognises whether an apparent agreement is meaningful.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in mediation responsibility or decision rights.

reach.task: Facilitate discussion of a transport-related development alternative

evidence.claim: Community mediation and collaborative planning alternatives depend on contextual human interaction; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is mediation and assistance with alternatives, excluding technical impact modelling and formal approval decisions.

Participants provide concerns during s1; the planner clarifies and records interests through the existing process. No new structured sentiment score, extra participant questionnaire or automatic preference ranking is assumed.
Use existing documents and meeting facilities before any build.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new component or recurring process is introduced.
research_questions: Which disagreements require better evidence and which require negotiation about competing interests?

already_counted.description: Mediation and collaborative development of alternatives

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; mediation and collaborative judgement are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend proposal approval, denial or conditions

steps.what: Weigh proposal evidence, planning criteria and unresolved issues
Recommend approval, denial or conditional approval of proposals

tasks.design: Keep the recommendation with the planner using assessed evidence in {DOCS}. The planner verifies the reasoning and any proposed conditions before handing the exact recommendation to the authorised decision maker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Approval recommendations depend on the weight and limits of the evidence and applicable criteria.
tasks.enabler_now: No new component is proposed for the recommendation decision.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing competing considerations and defining conditions that address the actual issue.
tasks.human_edge: The planner explains why the evidence supports the recommendation and recognises unresolved matters.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in recommendation responsibility or final decision authority.

reach.task: Explain how environmental evidence affects proposed planning conditions
reach.learn: Impact assessment limits and condition verification

evidence.claim: Planning recommendations require contextual judgement; no automatic approval or labour reduction is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is weighing an already assessed proposal and making a recommendation, excluding underlying studies and the authority's final decision.

Existing assessment and consultation work supplies evidence before s1. The planner produces reasoning in s1 and checks the exact recommendation and conditions in s2. No new structured eligibility flag, automatic legal conclusion or unpaid specialist work is assumed.
Use existing decision records and native document facilities before custom code; overlapping assessment work is counted once.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new component or process is introduced.
unknowns: Who can make the final decision
research_questions: Which unresolved issues prevent a reasoned recommendation even when document preparation is complete?

already_counted.description: Evidence weighing and exact recommendation checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact recommendation, proposal version, rationale, proposed conditions and decision-maker destination; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0. Recommendation judgement and formal decision work remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate land-use factors and analyse research data

steps.what: Define field investigations, surveys and land-use research methods
Conduct field investigations and capture land-use research observations
Compile checked observations into study tables and maps
Analyze land-use factors and investigate study limitations

tasks.design: Use native study forms and mapping tools in {OTHER} to compile observations captured during fieldwork. The planner retains method design, data collection and interpretation, recording study limitations in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checked field observations are repeatedly copied into tables and map layers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form exports and fixed table and map templates can compile explicit fields.
tasks.still_hard: Missing coverage, inconsistent observations and drawing conclusions beyond the study design.
tasks.human_edge: The planner chooses a credible method and understands what the observations cannot establish.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated compilation; fieldwork and analytical responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Sampling limits and spatial field definitions

evidence.claim: Native compilation of explicit field observations into specified tables and maps is plausible; the task-specific time reduction is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is method selection, field research, compilation and analysis, excluding separate infrastructure proposal evaluation and specialist studies.

OTHER means existing survey capture and geographic information tools. The planner defines the observation schema, units, coordinate reference, grouping and missing-data rules in s1, and produces checked location, observation time, factor, value, unit, method and source reference fields in s2. All field measurement, respondent interaction, selection and capture time remains counted.

Native compilation consumes only the specified checked fields; unstructured accounts and invalid locations remain manual exceptions in s4. No new respondent form, unpaid specialist capture or automatic causal inference is assumed.
Test native exports and mapping templates before custom code. Already automatic compilation earns no new saving.
unknowns: Study-specific missing-data and spatial quality issues
research_questions: Does native compilation reduce total study time after field capture, spatial checks and exception handling?

already_counted.description: Method design, field capture, analysis and compilation exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain study templates and compare sample outputs with source observations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85 gives gross15 and net8 after7 focal upkeep;2 support hours remain visible. Range1-4% assumes recurring manually compiled observations with compatible fields; fieldwork and interpretation stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate development proposals for environmental impact and sustainability

steps.what: Select environmental impact questions and check proposal documents
Locate proposal evidence about environmental impacts and sustainability

loop.purpose: Locate relevant passages without assessing acceptability
loop.input: selected proposal and report versions plus assessment questions
loop.output: source-linked evidence passages, uncertainties and unanswered questions
loop.check: Open originals and check units, scope, assumptions and qualifications; absence from extracted passages is not proof of no impact
loop.stop: One extraction and one targeted correction; planner reads manually when evidence or references are unclear
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native document search first; report language and cross-references vary beyond fixed keyword matching

steps.what: Evaluate proposal impacts, sustainability tradeoffs and unresolved evidence

tasks.design: A bounded reading step in {DOCS} locates report passages against the planner's checked questions. The planner reads originals, judges environmental impacts and sustainability tradeoffs, and identifies evidence still needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant evidence and caveats are spread across long reports and appendices.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked extraction can reduce passage hunting without deciding environmental acceptability.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing modelling limits, cumulative effects and competing sustainability objectives.
tasks.human_edge: The planner weighs evidence and recognises when specialist clarification is needed.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less passage hunting; impact judgement and recommendations remain human.

reach.task: Prepare precise requests for clarification of impact evidence
reach.learn: Study assumptions and specialist evidence limits

evidence.claim: Source-linked pre-reading of environmental reports is plausible; the digest's planning design suggestion is not a measured product case or saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the planner's proposal impact evaluation, excluding producing specialist studies and the separate approval recommendation. Overlapping research is assigned once.

Existing project proponents and specialists produce proposal and report documents before s1. The planner captures question, criteria reference, document identifier, version and required section scope in s1; all selection and capture remain counted. Missing documents or unreadable tables go to manual reading or clarification, never invented evidence.
The bounded step produces referenced candidate passages, not a structured acceptable-impact flag. Meaning review remains in s2 and judgement in s3. No unpaid specialist recoding is introduced.
Try native document search and standard checklists before a bounded model step.
research_questions: Does referenced pre-reading save time after original-report checks and specialist clarification?

already_counted.description: Question capture and contextual environmental evaluation
Check extracted passage meaning and correct references

incremental.description: Maintain extraction checks and inspect missed-caveat examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R89.5 gives gross10.5 and net4.5 after6 upkeep. Range0-2% allows dense appendices and ambiguous evidence to erase most retrieval gain; no impact judgement saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less field-data compilation and report passage hunting, with mediation and planning judgement retained.
reach: Prepare reproducible study outputs and specific specialist clarification requests
